payload.title: fgos-cli-fallback.md shared template prefers stale .fgos/installation/bin/fgos shim over live…
payload.description: fgos-cli-fallback.md shared template prefers stale .fgos/installation/bin/fgos shim over live bin/fgos.mjs in dev checkout, causing wrong verdicts. Confirmed: running cleanup tsk-hem via the staged shim returned 'not ready, TTL 5d not elapsed' (stale message text 'since entering cleanup' not found anywhere in current source), while node bin/fgos.mjs cleanup tsk-hem (same id, same moment) correctly returned to:done. The shared fallback (plugins/fgOS/skills/_shared/fgos-cli-fallback.md) checks FGOS_INSTALL_BIN before FGOS_BIN, so every plugin-skill CLI call in this dev checkout risks running stale staged logic instead of the current repo. Fix: in a dev checkout (bin/fgos.mjs present and this is the forgent repo itself), prefer bin/fgos.mjs over the installation shim, or detect/warn on staleness (e.g. compare shim's embedded version/hash against repo HEAD).
payload.verify: chưa xác định — P15 bổ sung
